title: Authorized Users and Employee Cards on Northgate Credit Cards
content:
A Northgate Credit Cards account may carry authorized users or, on the business products, employee cards, up to a maximum set per card product. The table also states whether those users' purchases earn rewards to the account.

## Account features sheet

| Card product | Authorized users or employee cards on the account (maximum) | Authorized users' purchases earn rewards to the account |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | 4 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 20 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 4 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 20 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 4 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 20 | Yes |

The maximum is 4 on each of the three consumer products and 20 on each of the three business products. On every product, the purchases of authorized users earn rewards to the account.

## Questions answered from the sheet

**How many employee cards may a Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus account carry?** Up to 20.

**An account on a Northgate Rewards Visa Signature already has 4 authorized users. Is a fifth within the maximum?** No. The maximum on that product is 4, and a fifth would exceed it.

**Do purchases by an authorized user on a Northgate Store Card earn rewards?** Yes; they earn to the account.

**Is the maximum the same on the store card and the Rewards Visa product of one segment?** Yes. The Northgate Store Card shares the consumer maximum of 4 with the two consumer Rewards Visa products, and the Northgate Business Store Card shares the business maximum of 20 with the two business Rewards Visa products.
